title: Refund-Window Uplift for Certificates Issued Late
content:
# Refund-window uplift

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the certificate product's refund window on SSL/TLS Certificates and the subscription's new-subscription charge date.

The refund-window uplift of the late-issuance goodwill follows how much of the product's refund window days, counted from the new-subscription charge date, passed before the initial issuance: where the days from that charge to the issuance exceed the refund window days, the uplift is $5.00; where they are 0.5 (half) of the refund window days or more but do not exceed them, the uplift is $3.00; where they are fewer, no uplift is added. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-issuance goodwill figure.

**Hypothetical refund window of 20 days:**

| Days from the new-subscription charge to the initial issuance | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | $5.00 |
| 10 to 20 | $3.00 |
| 9 or fewer | nothing |
